args:
launcher=bin/petit-poucet
root="$1"
case "$root" in *'$'* | '') root="$PLUGIN_ROOT" ;; esac
[ -f "$root/$launcher" ] || root=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.copilot/installed-plugins/*/petit-poucet 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
[ -f "$root/$launcher" ] || { echo 'petit-poucet: cannot locate the plugin directory' >&2; exit 1; }
exec sh "$root/$launcher" serve
